alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus pale brown, with two elongate pale patches between the ocelli; pronotum with a pale T marking; femora of the legs pale yellowish brown, tibiae darker. Body length with wings 6.39 to 7.17 mm, body length 5.68 to 6.60 mm. Head capsule oval, slightly wider than long, length 0.73 mm, width 0.77 to 0.78 mm; fontanelle small, the coronal suture visible. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest. The distance between the compound eyes and the ventral margin of the head less than one third of their long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.05 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes about equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, the median line dark, median length 0.19 to 0.20 mm, width 0.32 to 0.34 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.37 to 0.39 mm, width 0.58 to 0.59 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up, the posterior margin concave in the middle. Hind tibia 0.71 to 0.73 mm long.
biology: Builds dark brown water-chestnut-shaped or variously rounded hard-shelled nests under grass roots, about 3 to 6 cm in diameter; no damage has yet been observed, and it may be beneficial for soil improvement.
distribution: Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Taishan, Dianbai, Zhanjiang, Haikang and Xuwen, Guangdong; also Hainan; Nanning, Pubei and Hepu, Guangxi.
soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Pilosity on the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel or narrowing backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight; the two frontal angles projecting as points; the dorsal margin of the head rather flat. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and half of segment 2. Labrum bell-shaped, with three pairs of short setae. Mandibles sabre-like, stout with the apex curved; the inner margin with both fine and coarse serrations, a coarse tooth at about the basal third, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the mandibular base very shallow; postmentum flat, the broad region at the anterior third, the waist region near the posterior margin; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin almost straight.
